prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1022
Claimant:
Nancy Johnson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2-17-24
Reported a sideswipe that occurred while the insured vehicle was changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant
was the driver of the insured vehicle, and the policyholder confirmed the driver is a mebmer of the household and
covered under the policy.
2-26-24
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene. The other driver's statement
describes the same lane change and contact along the passenger side.
3-11-24
Two independent witnesses were reached and both describe the vehicles making contact as one drifted into the
adjacent lane. Scene photos were received and show scraping and a dented rear quarter paenl consistent with the
reported impact.
4-5-24
Calimant reports pain in the right shoulder and was transported to an urgent care facility the same day. Medical
records requested and a treating provider has been identified.
4-20-24
Estimate received for the body work. Most of the damage appears to be in line with the described contact, and the
appraiser noted nothing that conflicts with the account given so far.
5-3-24
Claimant is now represented by an attorney, who has asked that all further contact go through their office. Recorded
the representation and paused direct contact with the claimant.
5-19-24
Treating physician notes describe a shoulder strain with a soft tissue component, which the adjuster considers a
reasonable match for the force of a side impact. Treatment has been physical therapy and over-the-counter
medication, and the notes show steady improvement.
5-31-24
Attorney's office provided a written account that adds a few small details, such as the exact position of the other
vehicle before the lane change. The core sequence of events remains the same as in the original report.
6-18-24
A neighbor contacted the desk and stated the insured vehicle appeared to have body damage several weeks before
the reported accident. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file, and the neighbor has not provided photos or other
support for the observation.
8-26-24
Reviewed prior claims and medical history databases. No earlier injury to the shoulder or other affected area has
been found for the claimant, and the vehicle shows no prior loss on record.
9-3-24
Physical therapy has tapered as the claimant's range of motion has returned, and the treating provider expects
discharge from active care soon. File remains open pending final medical bills and the attorney's demand package,
with the neighbor's comment noted for follow-up.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
